changelog:
DriveFight 0.16.1 improves ground contact during flips.

- Fast descending flips now sweep the car hull toward the floor, reducing clipping while keeping motion along the surface.
- Roof, side and nose scrapes preserve physical momentum without the extra crash slowdown.
- Ground contact ends forced dodge spin and restores attitude control; jump resources still require a proper landing.
- Automatic upright assistance respects the rotation-clearance check.

Protocol remains 8. Matching macOS, Windows and Linux server builds.
